subject: Linguistics
title: Face and Face Wants
description: A quick win: understand Face and Face Wants.

hook.text: Why say 'Would you mind...' instead of 'Do it'? Because you're protecting the listener's face.

buildup.text: Erving Goffman defined 'face' as the public self-image that everyone wants to maintain.

discovery.text: Positive face is the desire to be liked; negative face is the desire to not be imposed on.

twist.text: Every request threatens the listener's negative face—you're imposing on their freedom.

climax.text: Politeness strategies exist to minimize face threats while still getting things done.

punchline.text: Language is a constant negotiation of social image.

quiz.question: What is 'positive face'?
options: The desire to be liked and approved of
